Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 tmp_add_on_bags number;
 tmp_bag_code number;
 temp_count number;
 temp_count1 number;
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from units
 where unit_ID = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 select count(*) into temp_count1 from arc_log_det
 where
 unit_id=:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and chapter_ID = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id := '';
 :ctrl_blk_1.chk_digit := '';
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date := '';
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 if temp_count1 > 0 then
 show_error('0214');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('0210');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 else
 begin
 select max(coll_date)
 into :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 -- there cannot be situation where the
 -- chapter_id is not there but the collection
 -- date is there
 if :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :GLOBAL.chapter_id is null
 then
 :s_unit_id := '';
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 show_error('0179');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 begin
-- HCLC select substr(bag_code,2,1), add_on_bags
 select substr(bag_code,-1),add_on_bags --Modified By HCLC
 into tmp_bag_code, tmp_add_on_bags
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 nvl(chapter_id,'XX') =
 nvl(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,'XX') and
 nvl(coll_date,sysdate) =
 nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,sysdate);
 :s_total_comp_bags := tmp_bag_code +
 tmp_add_on_bags;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date);
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 :s_unit_id := '';
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 show_error('0131');
 else
 :system.message_level := 5;
 go_block('converted_products');
 execute_query;
 go_block('component_info');
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

declare
 temp_sp_gravity number;
begin 
 if :component_info.system_label_decision is not null
 then
 begin
 SELECT substr(abo_short_name,1,10)
 INTO :s_abo_desc
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE abo_label = :component_info.system_label_decision
 AND unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme 
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 365)
 AND rownum = 1; -- Added by Kishore on 01/07/2015. IM 10314 
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 null;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 begin
 select specific_gravity
 into temp_sp_gravity
 from valid_products
 where product_code = substr(:component_info.product_code,1,5)
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1);
 exception
 when others then
 null;
 end;
 if temp_sp_gravity is not null and :component_info.component_weight is not null
 then
 :component_info.comp_vol := :component_info.component_weight / temp_sp_gravity;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: ATTR_INTER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure attr_inter is
 temp_count number;
begin
 if :component_info.product_code != 'NONE'
 then
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from component_attributes
 where unit_ID = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_ID
 and chapter_ID = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_ID
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date)
 and product_code = :s_cur_product_code;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.component_no_attrib := 'Y';
 else
 :GLOBAL.component_no_attrib := 'N';
 end if;
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from component_interdictions
 where unit_ID = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_ID
 and chapter_ID = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_ID
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date)
 and product_code = :s_cur_product_code;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.component_no_inter := 'Y';
 else
 :GLOBAL.component_no_inter := 'N';
 end if;
 begin
 select product_desc
 into :s_cur_product_code_desc
 from valid_products
 where product_code = substr(:s_cur_product_code,1,5) and --HCLC
 unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end;
 if :GLOBAL.component_no_attrib = 'Y' and
 :GLOBAL.component_no_inter = 'Y'
 then
 show_error('0068');
 check_package_Failure;
 end if;
 :GLOBAL.field_left := :system.cursor_field;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 go_block('component_attributes');
 execute_query;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('COMPONENT_ATTRIBUTES.ATTRIB_GROUP',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'COMPONENT_ATTRIBUTES.ATTRIB_GROUP', UPDATE_NULL, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 go_block('component_interdictions');
 execute_query;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('COMPONENT_INTERDICTIONS.INTER_CODE',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'COMPONENT_INTERDICTIONS.INTER_CODE', UPDATE_NULL, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if :GLOBAL.component_no_attrib = 'Y'
 then
 if :GLOBAL.component_no_inter = 'Y'
 then
 go_block('component_interdictions');
 end if;
 else
 go_block('component_attributes');
 end if;
 else
 show_error('0153');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;
